subject: Post-call recap + Mutual Action Plan (MajorCare pilot)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Tang <emma.tang@majorcare.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + Mutual Action Plan (MajorCare pilot)

Emma — thanks for your time today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) based on our discussion so the team is aligned. I captured pain, goals, stakeholders, and a proposed milestone sequence you can share internally.

Pain / context we heard
- MajorCare wants to reduce triage time and support load by surfacing high-precision summaries from patient notes; current infra struggles with bursty traffic and latency spikes.
- Data sensitivity / PHI handling is top concern — you need KMS + audit logs and isolated tenancy for pilot.

Goal (30–60 day pilot)
- Validate end-to-end latency (95th <= 350ms for 512 tokens), assess top-line quality on 3 representative care workflows, and produce cost projection for 100k monthly queries.

Proposed MAP (high level)
1) Scope alignment & access (Mar 23): share sample dataset snapshot (anonymized) and accept security checklist. Owner: MajorCare (Emma) / Redwood (Laura).
2) Pilot deployment (Mar 30–Apr 06): spin up private pilot in dedicated VPC, baseline tests during low traffic. Owner: Redwood infra (Marcus).
3) Quality evaluation (Apr 07–Apr 14): run 1k queries through eval harness, share metrics and a short quality report. Owner: MajorCare clinical lead / Redwood PM (Aditya).
4) Cost & ops review (Apr 15): review token/unit costs, batching profile, and a production readiness checklist. Owner: Finance & Platform.
5) Decision gate (Apr 20): internal MajorCare decision to expand to 1 region or proceed to contract. Decision criteria: latency SLOs met, no unresolved PHI controls, exec sponsor sign-off.

Stakeholders (as discussed)
- MajorCare: Emma Tang (Clinical AI), Carlos Rios (Procurement; cc later), Dr. Lina Park (Clinical QA)
- Redwood: Laura Bennett (AE), Marcus Lin (Solutions Eng), Aditya Rao (Product PM)

Risks / open questions
- We'll need a shared anonymization script; MajorCare to confirm whether the sample set can be de-identified by Mar 23.
- Procurement timeline: Carlos — is a PO or SOW preferred for pilot?

Next steps (owned)
- Emma: confirm sample data availability + add procurement contact (by Mon, Mar 23).
- Laura: circulate MAP xls + security checklist (attached) and schedule 30-min kickoff (by Mon, Mar 23).
- Marcus: prepare pilot infra checklist and tentative sizing.

Attachments: MajorCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), pilot-scope-appendix.pdf (technical guardrails).

Thanks again — I’ll schedule the kickoff once you confirm procurement contact.

—
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
https://redwoodinference.com

From: Emma Tang <emma.tang@majorcare.health>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + Mutual Action Plan (MajorCare pilot)

Laura — thanks for the tidy recap, very helpful. Quick responses inline: 

- Sample data: we can provide a 3k-record anonymized extract by COB Mar 23. We'll use our in-house de-id pipeline; I'll attach a note from our data ops team if needed.
- Procurement: Carlos is our procurement lead — he'll likely ask for a short SOW and a one-month pilot PO. Copying him now.

Carlos Rios <c.rios@majorcare.health>

Question: for the decision gate on Apr 20, can you clarify what "exec sponsor sign-off" will look like? Are you expecting a one-pager + cost estimate or a live exec demo?

Also, what does Redwood need from Dr. Lina Park for the quality evaluation (any template or sample prompts)?

—
Emma
Director, Clinical AI | MajorCare Health
emma.tang@majorcare.health | +1 212-555-4401

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Tang <emma.tang@majorcare.health>, Carlos Rios <c.rios@majorcare.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + Mutual Action Plan (MajorCare pilot)

Emma / Carlos — great, appreciate the quick turn. Short answers and next files attached.

Decision gate: Exec sponsor sign-off = 1) one-page results summary (latency, precision/recall for the three workflows), 2) cost projection for scaled run, and 3) a ~15 minute live exec demo for stakeholders. We find that a short deck + demo gets the right stakeholder alignment. I included a one-pager template in the attached MAP.

Quality eval inputs for Dr. Lina Park: we attached a sample prompt set and expected output format (CSV with gold labels + reviewer notes). If MajorCare has specific clinical acceptance thresholds, flag them early so we can include them in the evaluation script.

Updated MAP highlights (attached) — small changes: moved pilot deploy window to Mar 31–Apr 07 to align with your dev schedule; added an internal Redwood checkpoint on Apr 09 for tuning and batching config.

Proposed immediate cadence:
- Kickoff meeting (30 min) — Thu Mar 26, 10:00–10:30 PT (invite to follow)
- Weekly sync (30 min) — Mon mornings during pilot

Attachments included in this message: MajorCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + one-pager template), pilot-scope-appendix.pdf (de-id checklist + infra requirements).

Action items:
- Carlos: if PO is the path, can you share typical PO lead time and any PO terms that mandate special clauses? (requested by Wed Mar 25)
- Emma: confirm kickoff time or propose alternatives (by Wed Mar 25)
- Marcus: will share pilot sizing + infra checklist before kickoff.

Thanks — I’ll send the invite once Carlos confirms procurement path.

—
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + Mutual Action Plan (MajorCare pilot)

Looping in a quick note on infra sizing & a pricing pointer for the kickoff:

- Sizing: for the pilot load (1k/day, bursty), proposed reserved pool = 1x A10G-equivalent with autoscale burst to 2x for peak tests. That should keep 95th latency comfortably under target.
- Pricing: pilot PO can be structured as a fixed-month pilot fee plus usage overage. For the MAP we should show two options on the one-pager: (A) pilot fee only (limited SLA) and (B) pilot + dedicated reserved capacity (SLA + lower per-token).

I’ll attach a simple cost comparison slide to the kickoff invite.

—
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
